NEWS: Tesla has officially built 750,000 vehicles at Giga Berlin.

The factory has become one of Tesla’s most important production hubs in Europe, helping scale Model Y output while pushing manufacturing speed and efficiency higher.

Reaching this number takes more than robots and assembly lines. It takes massive coordination across batteries, supply chains, software and thousands of workers operating in sync every day.

Giga Berlin keeps growing and Tesla’s production machine keeps accelerating.

NEWS: You can now clone your own voice with the xAI API.

Businesses can use it to build AI assistants, automate support calls and create voice-powered workflows that sound exactly like the owner or brand.

Setup is surprisingly simple. Just choose “Clone a Voice,” read the short prompt and the system trains your voice model in under 2 minutes.

This opens the door to AI services that feel far more personal and human.

UPDATE: Grok Connectors has officially arrived on iOS and Android.

Your phone can now connect Grok directly to Gmail, Google Calendar, Drive, GitHub, Microsoft 365, Notion, Linear and even custom company tools through MCP.

Instead of bouncing between apps, Grok can access your workflow in one place and help manage tasks, meetings, files and projects in real time.

This is starting to feel less like a chatbot and more like a full AI workspace in your pocket.
